title: Documenting the client systems and controls

items.question: Has the accounting system or method been described (software, spreadsheets, manual books), including who enters and who approves transactions?
Has the revenue cycle been documented, from order or contract to invoice, receipt of money and recording?
Has the purchases and payments cycle been documented, from approval to payment and recording?
Has the payroll process been documented, including statutory deductions and who approves the payroll?
Has the cash and bank process been documented, including who signs, who reconciles and how often?
Has the month-end and year-end close process been documented, including how journals are prepared and approved?
Has the team noted which controls are designed well enough to rely on, and which are missing or weak, with a walkthrough performed for key ones?
Has the team recorded any weakness in segregation of duties and what the team will do about it?
